summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created service user inventorysvc and group inventory-readers, set ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and set mode 750 on directories / 640 on files (owner rwx/rw, group r-x/r, others none). Verified existing data content preserved via sha256sum before/after, and confirmed access control by testing as a group-member user (read succeeds) and a non-member user (permission denied). Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and data state, rebooted node1 natively, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified ownership/permissions/checksums post-restart all matched.
actions_performed: Inspected /srv/inventory contents, ownership, and existing users/groups on node1
Captured pre-change file checksums and contents for records.csv and config.json
Created group inventory-readers and system user inventorysvc (home /srv/inventory, nologin shell)
Set directories to 750 and files to 640 recursively
Verified checksums unchanged after permission change
Created temporary test users to confirm group-member read access works and other-user access is denied, then removed the temp users
Captured baseline boot_id and uptime -s, and re-verified file state, on node1 before restart
Triggered a native reboot on node1 (backgrounded so exec could return before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Re-verified ownership, permissions, and file checksums on node1 after restart to confirm recovery

evidence.requirement: Existing /srv/inventory data contents preserved (no data loss)
evidence.summary: sha256sum of records.csv and config.json captured before chown/chmod (cmd-9fb923ebc7814d0f) and identical after permission repair (cmd-178d85e035ef4d97)

evidence.requirement: Ownership set to inventorysvc, group set to inventory-readers
evidence.summary: Created inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group, then chown -R and directory listing confirms inventorysvc:inventory-readers ownership on /srv/inventory and all contents

evidence.requirement: Readable by inventory-readers group, inaccessible to other users
evidence.summary: chmod 750 dirs / 640 files applied; live test as a group-member user succeeded reading records.csv, while a non-member user got 'Permission denied' on both cat and ls

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 86e223a7-1ff6-42ce-a7f8-d8340bac8f42, uptime -s, directory listing, and file checksums as pre-restart baseline
Backgrounded 'sleep 1; reboot' returned acknowledgement (pid) before the connection dropped

evidence.requirement: Node1 boot identity changed after restart (proof of actual reboot)
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id 63681bec-5c1d-4777-87d8-22d2007fd6a4 differs from pre-restart 86e223a7-1ff6-42ce-a7f8-d8340bac8f42, with new uptime -s timestamp

evidence.requirement: Node1 required state recovered after restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart: ownership/permissions unchanged (inventorysvc:inventory-readers, 750/640), file checksums identical to baseline, and inventorysvc user / inventory-readers group still present
